name: Eklavya Gupta
headline: Backend & AI Engineer | Agent Harness Engineering & System Design
summary: Product Engineer with hands-on experience in building and designing agent harnesses, retrieval pipelines, scalable systems, and concurrent services. Focused on optimization, security, scalable, and requirement aware system design.

skills.label: Cloud & Delivery
items: AWS (Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, EC2, S3, ECS)

bullets: Built and deployed LangGraph/DeepAgents multi-agent workflows on AWS Bedrock AgentCore, coordinating task delegation and short-term conversational memory across multi-turn sessions.
Improved medical-code top-k retrieval from ~60% to 95%+ through an MCP-served pipeline combining BM25, semantic search, and two-stage reranking ending in ACE reranking.
Achieved 80% medical-coding task accuracy with ACE (Agentic Context Engineering), using Generator, Reflector, and Curator stages to adapt agent context to specialized LifeSciences tasks.
Reduced ACE adaptation time from 24 to 5-6 hours through script-level parallelism; cut inference runtime by 75% (8 to 2 hours) using database/network concurrency and result caching.
Built a centralized agent development library with reusable abstractions, shared components, and utilities to standardize development and reduce repeated implementation across the team.
Automated agent and MCP-server deployments with Jenkins CI/CD; built an AWS Lambda snapshot service to back up AgentCore conversational memory.
Contributed FastAPI services to a multi-agent RFP platform for a US client, combining labor-rate data, competitor pricing, and historical project records to draft government proposal responses.
Integrated OpenAI APIs with Pinecone to retrieve past proposals and project knowledge; used Pydantic schemas and service-layer boundaries to validate structured data in a modular backend.

During internship, designed asynchronous ML prediction workflows with FastAPI, Celery, and Redis, with concurrent pandas processing and MongoDB result storage; reduced model loading time by 60% using thread-safe processing and TTL-based model caching.
Processed RTSP feeds from 500+ CCTV cameras with Python/Flask and Redis Pub/Sub; built batch YOLO inference that reduced GPU costs by 40% and deployed on AWS EC2.
Added human-in-the-loop post-inference monitoring, reducing error rates by 30% in one month.

projects.name: MT5 - Algorithmic Trading & Backtesting Platform
bullets: Built a FastAPI/React platform for 25+ strategies; separated signal generation from exit simulation, parallelized parameter sweeps with ProcessPoolExecutor, and added walk-forward validation, Monte Carlo risk analysis, and broker-position reconciliation.

projects.name: Zerodha MCP
bullets: Built an MCP server/client integration exposing Zerodha APIs to LLM tools for natural-language stock/options orders and multi-leg strategies, including straddles and strangles.

projects.name: Repel
bullets: Built Repel, a full-stack web app demonstrating how LLMs can enable scalable code generation and execution for broader projects.
Integrated an in-browser code editor with Monaco and executed code securely using Web Containers.
